definitions.explanation: The outcome or result of an action.
The degree to which something produces the desired result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効果|こうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The medicine is starting to take effect.

examples.english: If you keep up this exercise, you should see results from the diet.

examples.english: To study effectively, the first important thing is to make a plan.

notes:
{効果|こうか} means effect, result, or effectiveness. Used broadly for the outcomes of actions, treatments, policies, and methods.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {効果|こうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have an effect
- {効果|こうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: the effect appears/shows
- {効果|こうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no effect
- {効果|こうか}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧（⟦な→な：09497_na⟧）: effective
- {効果|こうか}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: effectively

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧{効果|こうか}: counterproductive effect, backfire
- ⟦{相乗|そうじょう}→相乗：28174_soujou⟧{効果|こうか}: synergistic effect
- ⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧: side effect
- ⟦{温室|おんしつ}→温室：04116_onshitsu⟧{効果|こうか}: greenhouse effect
- ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧{効果|こうか}: sound effects

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: result, outcome (neutral — what happened)
- {効果|こうか}: effect (implies intended or desired result)
- ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: influence, impact (broader, can be positive or negative)
